sections.title: Player text
sections.body: Your steeds haul the carriage around a tight bend and stop hard. The path ahead is blocked: a vendor cart lies overturned, its fruit, vegetables, and spilled preserves scattered across the trail. Something has been feeding here. The air is wrong: sweet rot and something underneath it, coppery. From the far side of the cart, you hear wet, unhurried movement.

sections.title: Public objective
sections.body: Figure out what happened here and clear the road.

sections.title: GM goal
sections.body: Block the road with a wrecked vendor cart, let the table read the scene, and plant that the obvious animal story does not add up.

sections.title: GM notes
items: Use the wreck as an investigation scene first and a creature reveal second.
Player-safe language: body, feeding, blade wound. GM-only truth: staged murder and later Bramble connection.

sections.title: GM script
sections.body: Say: "The carriage stops hard. Ahead of you is a wreck, a body, and something feeding just out of sight. You can rush toward the sound, but you have time to look first. What do you check?" If someone checks the body, say: "The feeding is messy, but the killing wound is clean. This was not done by claws." If they need the roll, call Knowledge or Instinct, Difficulty 12.

sections.title: State controls
items: slitThroatDiscovered Slit throat discovered checkbox Carry this forward as the first crack in the animal-attack story.
brambleSeedFound Bramble seed found checkbox Use only as a seed; do not resolve the later faction connection in Act 1.
